chapters.title: PIM for Azure resources and audit benefits

takeaways: Standing privileges leave admin rights active around the clock although they are used only briefly, turning every compromised admin account into a potential disaster.
PIM makes users eligible instead of permanently active, so roles are activated just in time with a time limit, MFA, justification and optional approval, and every activation is audited.
Start by making your global admin accounts eligible, keep activation windows short, require MFA on activation and keep separate break-glass accounts.
hook: Most organizations give admins permanent rights they use for only a few minutes a week, leaving the door open for attackers. This episode explains Microsoft Entra Privileged Identity Management in plain English for admins and security owners. You will learn how eligible assignments, just-in-time activation and approvals shrink your attack surface and which pitfalls to avoid.
